chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
There is no issue with salat (prayer) on reed mats, on palm-leaf mats, and on every plant, except fruit.

key_terms.الْبُورِيَاءِ: reed matting used as a surface
key_terms.الْخَصَفَةِ: a mat woven from palm leaves
key_terms.بِالصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer being discussed

ai.seo_question: What plant-based materials are permissible to pray on in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the permissibility of performing salat (prayer) upon certain natural plant-based materials. It indicates that reed mats, palm-leaf mats, and other vegetation are permissible, while fruit is excluded from this allowance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.804 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that He said:
"There is no issue with praying on mats made from reeds or on palm-leaf mats, and on any plant-based material, except for fruit”.
